info.title: XMLDoc2Markdown
info.description: Tool to generate markdown from C# XML documentation.

options.name: --index-page-name
options.description: Name of the index page [default: index]

options.name: --examples-path
options.description: Path to the code examples to insert in the documentation

options.name: --platform
options.description: Target documentation host. Presets link rewriting and front matter; override any of those with --link-extension / --link-prefix / --front-matter. [default: plain]

options.name: --link-extension
options.description: Override the link file extension ('md' keeps '.md', 'none' strips it). Defaults to the platform preset.

options.name: --link-prefix
options.description: Override the link prefix ('relative' keeps './', 'none' strips it). Defaults to the platform preset.

options.name: --back-button
options.description: Add a back button on each page [default: False]

options.name: --member-accessibility-level
options.description: Minimum accessibility level of members to be documented. [default: protected]

options.name: --front-matter
options.description: Override the front matter preset emitted for a documentation system. Defaults to the platform preset.

options.name: --front-matter-field
options.description: Extra front matter 'key=value' pair, merged on top of the preset (repeatable). Value emitted verbatim.
